cases.name: AC-1 edge: 7 characters rejected, 8 letters and digits accepted
AC-1 missing letters, missing digits, empty string, symbols only or digits only all report ACC-1; abcd1234x passes
AC-2 mixed case is rejected too (PASSWORD1, Larkspur123, Qwerty123)
AC-2 WEAK_PASSWORDS has exactly 45 entries, no duplicates (as given, none added or removed)
AC-3 edge: containing the last 6 digits is rejected (anywhere), only the last 5 is not
AC-3 checks only the last 6 digits: a phone number prefix is not rejected; with no phone number (missing, empty, no ctx) nothing is checked
AC-4 strength: anything that fails ACC-1 to ACC-3 is weak, however long
AC-4 strength edges: 11 characters with three classes is medium, 12 with three classes is strong, 12 with only two classes is medium
AC-4 ok matches level: ok false is always weak, ok true is never weak
AC-5 the password stays out of logs: checkPassword calls no console method and its return value holds no password text
ACC-1: at least 8 characters, with both letters and digits
ACC-2: no common weak password may pass, case-insensitive
ACC-3: must not contain the last 6 digits of the person's phone number
ACC-4: setting and resetting a password both validate with checkPassword; the old 6-character rule is gone
ACC-4: password.ts is pure logic, Node can load it directly
ACC-4: the page shows the strength and the unmet rules as you type
ACC-4: strength is weak, medium or strong
ACC-5: the password never goes to a log or local storage
FE-3: no dangerouslySetInnerHTML in the login package
